    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">记一次综合型流量分析 | 添柴不加火</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        这是一道非常杂且考验你基本功的流量分析
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p></p><div class="toc"><div class="toc-container-header">目录</div><ul><li><a href="#前言" rel="noopener nofollow">前言</a></li><li><a href="#流量分析" rel="noopener nofollow">流量分析</a></li></ul></div><p></p>
<h2 id="前言">前言</h2>
<p>本题考点：图片隐写、流量分析、AES解密<br>
这是一道考验你基本功的非常杂的题目<br>
前置知识：</p>
<ul>
<li>需要了解图片隐写的常见姿势</li>
<li>会从流量包中导出文件</li>
<li>了解PDF文件隐写</li>
<li>了解基本的流量分析过滤语法</li>
<li>了解AES对称加密</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="流量分析">流量分析</h2>
<p>打开流量包，映入眼帘的是HTTP流，发现上传了一张jpg图片<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327103919169-1043998490.png" alt="w1" loading="lazy"><br>
过滤一下get请求<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104042418-1240407617.png" alt="w2" loading="lazy"><br>
发现了六张图片和一个pdf，全部导出，追踪HTTP流，导出原始数据<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104107074-408300556.png" alt="w3" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104113622-933846480.png" alt="w4" loading="lazy"><br>
将请求头删除后保存<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104136398-1310138096.png" alt="w5" loading="lazy"><br>
导出6张图片和1个pdf，又从第三张图片中分里出来一个压缩包，压缩包是AES加密，pdf中发现隐藏字符串；剩下5张图片是迷惑，出题人坏得很啊，用尽浑身解数愣是没分析出来什么实质性的东西<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104152820-461754531.png" alt="w6" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104159373-1584310495.png" alt="w7" loading="lazy"><br>
继续分析流量，发现dns流中有线索，刚开始只过滤了dns，后来发现过滤dns.txt可以一步到位<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104217229-1679837207.png" alt="w8" loading="lazy"><br>
发现了加密密钥key   key: a2poZ2Zkc2Fxc2Fu<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104244488-142849289.png" alt="w9" loading="lazy"><br>
又发现了aes加密的运算模式：OFB<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104258019-1811048015.png" alt="w10" loading="lazy"><br>
还有cipher data（加密数据） ：5A+vWFNOMbF7P4S6aB8OthSvpRgYllftylywalCMIrA=<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104317300-508047710.png" alt="w11" loading="lazy"><br>
最后发现vi偏移：a2poZ2Zkc2Fxc2Fu<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104338086-2055890703.png" alt="w12" loading="lazy"><br>
得到了AES解密的全部条件，接下来进行解密操作<br>
在线解密网站：<a href="https://www.toolhelper.cn/SymmetricEncryption/AES" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.toolhelper.cn/SymmetricEncryption/AES</a><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104403279-402766658.png" alt="w13" loading="lazy"><br>
得到密码：sansan@sanjiuadmin+++<br>
PDF隐藏：a6e3s51e9s4fs5<br>
接下来进行解密压缩包，刚开始以为要拼接这两个密码，发现不对，结果是压缩包有两层加密，先用a6e3s51e9s4fs5解第一层加密，再用sansan@sanjiuadmin+++解第二层加密，由此可见出题人就是坏呀，老是挖坑。<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104417669-1995967908.png" alt="w14" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260327104421319-2087402289.png" alt="w15" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<p>至此，本题分析完成，感谢支持！</p>
